title: Staleness Adder on Rate Lock Commitment Relocks
content:
**Pricing schedule: staleness of a Rate Lock Commitment relock.** The longer an expired lock goes unrelocked, the more is added to its relocked price.

The lapsed days are the calendar days from the expiration date the expired lock carries to the date of its latest relock request in the lock request log. A staleness adder is added to the relocked price, which is rounded to three decimal places.

**Rule.**

- When the lapsed days are at least **10** days (the long staleness days), the long staleness adder of **0.25** points is added.
- When they are at least **3** days (the staleness days) but fewer than 10, the staleness adder of **0.125** points is added.
- Otherwise none is added.

| Lapsed days | Adder (points) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | 0 |
| 3 to 9 | 0.125 |
| 10 or more | 0.25 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical, expiration date 1 June):* a relock request dated 3 June has 2 lapsed days, so no adder applies. One dated 4 June has 3 lapsed days, so 0.125 points are added. One dated 10 June has 9 lapsed days, so 0.125 points are added. One dated 11 June has 10 lapsed days, so 0.25 points are added.
